endorsements.quote: Relevant KPIs across the AI lifecycle include costs of deployment, integration, monitoring, maintenance, and retraining, either individually or combined as an aggregate metric.

Consequently, the scorecard approach can provide a critical checkpoint for integrating new, governance-intensive IT like AI: organizations unable to define a scorecard for AI may need to postpone adoption.

unlisted_practices: Healthcare organizations should integrate mission-driven values with financial metrics in strategic AI governance decisions.
Organizations should manage AI lifecycle costs, including deployment, integration, monitoring, maintenance, and retraining, as part of cost-aware governance.
Organizations should monitor model drift across the AI lifecycle to identify when to retrain, replace, or sunset AI models.
Organizations should address tension between hospital financial gain and mission-driven values when adopting AI.

screen.reason: Proposes a conceptual governance framework (Total Mission Value) for evaluating the economic and mission-aligned value of AI in healthcare.
